channel.title: ASI Law: Sovereign of the Chaos Sea
channel.description: An original web novel by czverse.

item.title: Chapter 120: The Lamp
item.description: Walter Ashby spoke to his great-granddaughter at six in the morning, in the children's ward of the Port Halvard hospital, by candlelight.

item.title: Chapter 119: Something Loud
item.description: He did not say it. He could not have said it. He was in the middle of a fire with a burning old man in one hand and a staff in the other and threads of himself being pulled out of him one at a time…

item.title: Chapter 118: No Lock
item.description: Outside the sphere, Lingyue saw his face change.

item.title: Chapter 117: The Light
item.description: Walter Ashby died at 3:40 in the morning, in a white bed in the round room under the glass dome, with the rain running down it and the dark sphere on its pedestal three meters away.

item.title: Chapter 116: The Sand
item.description: It took Doctor Iris Kwan four days to find where the sphere had come from.

item.title: Chapter 115: The Lighthouse Keeper
item.description: Port Halvard was gray, and it was raining, and the lights were going out.

item.title: Chapter 114: Yes Means Yes
item.description: "They asked," said Sister Ning.

item.title: Chapter 113: The Ember Line
item.description: The first message from inside the Mouth came on the thirty-first night.

item.title: Chapter 112: Sorry, Out Loud
item.description: The seven Architects asked to go to Port Abiri first.

item.title: Chapter 111: The Doorway
item.description: They buried Captain Zhao Gangfeng standing up.

item.title: Chapter 110: Lanterns
item.description: He watched it from the cold place.

item.title: Chapter 109: Burn Bright
item.description: "No," said Yuanshu.

item.title: Chapter 108: The Key
item.description: The whole of Blue Star saw the Low Fire arrive.

item.title: Chapter 107: The Fall
item.description: A Hunger does not ride the currents. It falls.

item.title: Chapter 106: Sixty Seconds
item.description: Zhou Xiaoyu had a clipboard, a stopwatch, and a whistle, and the whole of Lingzhou was afraid of her.

item.title: Chapter 105: The Low Fire
item.description: It took nine days to ask them all.

item.title: Chapter 104: The Sixth
item.description: The mouth of the second ring was cold.

item.title: Chapter 103: Halfway
item.description: The Architects came back on the fourth day, walking across the dark.

item.title: Chapter 102: Two Rafts
item.description: "How long," said Yuanshu, "until the other two reach Blue Star?"

item.title: Chapter 101: Who Asks
item.description: Nobody answered for three days.
